extraction_notes: Extracted SI catalyst-performance data from SI Figure S19 and SI Tables S3-S5. Literature rows in SI Table S3 were excluded; only the 'This work' ZnZr/90Cu 12000 mL/gcat./h row was used, while the 48000 mL/gcat./h row is represented by SI Table S5. SI Figures S20-S24 contain temperature-series plots for conversion/selectivity/STY, but the plotted markers/bars are not numerically labelled and are too low-resolution/dense for reliable complete digitization beyond the values already captured from SI Figure S19 and SI Tables S3-S5. Characterization, DRIFTS, DFT and literature-comparison data were otherwise excluded.
